WITH filtered_items AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT i_item_sk AS item_sk,
           i_manager_id AS manager_id
    FROM item
    WHERE (i_category IN ('Books','Children','Electronics')
           AND i_class IN ('personal','portable','reference','self-help')
           AND i_brand IN ('scholaramalgamalg #14','scholaramalgamalg #7','exportiunivamalg #9','scholaramalgamalg #9'))
       OR (i_category IN ('Women','Music','Men')
           AND i_class IN ('accessories','classical','fragrances','pants')
           AND i_brand IN ('amalgimporto #1','edu packscholar #1','exportiimporto #1','importoamalg #1'))
),
filtered_dates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk AS date_sk,
           d_moy AS month_of_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1222 AND 1233
),
item_month_sales AS (
    SELECT fi.manager_id AS manager_id,
           md.month_of_year AS month_of_year,
           md.month_sales AS month_sales
    FROM filtered_items fi
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT fd.month_of_year AS month_of_year,
               SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS month_sales
        FROM store_sales ss
        JOIN filtered_dates fd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = fd.date_sk
        JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
        WHERE ss.ss_item_sk = fi.item_sk
        GROUP BY fd.month_of_year
    ) md
),
manager_month_sales AS (
    SELECT manager_id AS manager_id,
           month_of_year AS month_of_year,
           SUM(month_sales) AS sum_sales
    FROM item_month_sales
    GROUP BY manager_id, month_of_year
),
manager_stats AS (
    SELECT manager_id AS manager_id,
           SUM(sum_sales) AS total_sales,
           COUNT(sum_sales) AS month_count
    FROM manager_month_sales
    GROUP BY manager_id
),
manager_avg AS (
    SELECT manager_id AS manager_id,
           CASE WHEN month_count > 0 AND total_sales IS NOT NULL
                THEN total_sales / CAST(month_count AS numeric)
                ELSE NULL
           END AS avg_monthly_sales
    FROM manager_stats
)
SELECT mm.manager_id AS i_manager_id,
       mm.sum_sales AS sum_sales,
       ma.avg_monthly_sales AS avg_monthly_sales
FROM manager_month_sales mm
JOIN manager_avg ma ON mm.manager_id = ma.manager_id
WHERE CASE WHEN ma.avg_monthly_sales > 0
           THEN abs(mm.sum_sales - ma.avg_monthly_sales) / ma.avg_monthly_sales
           ELSE NULL
      END > 0.1
ORDER BY mm.manager_id, ma.avg_monthly_sales, mm.sum_sales
LIMIT 100
